news.title: Alphabet’s record-breaking $85B raise for Google’s AI business is a helluva good signal
news.description: If Alphabet's record-breaking $85 billion stock sale signals investor appetite for AI-related offerings, we can see that investors are ready to chow.

news.title: Google’s Dreambeans, its weirdest-named AI tool to date, will turn your life into a cartoon
news.description: Dreambeans is a curated list of AI-illustrated "stories" culled from the personal data in your Google account.

news.title: Amazon will show AI product images when you search for some reason
news.description: Amazon will use visual search and AI to show AI-generated product images that match your search queries. The retailer says it will help guide users to products.

news.title: These two founders left Goldman and Meta to build voice AI for markets everyone else overlooked
news.description: The startup's own stack for Africa and Middle East is now handling more than 17,000 calls per day.

news.title: Phone signal on trains not good enough most of the time, research says
news.description: Ofcom found the major phone networks were not providing good signal on trains, and train companies were slowing down wi-fi.

news.title: Publishers in UK can opt out of Google AI search results
news.description: The Competition and Markets Authority says it would put publishers "in a stronger position to negotiate content deals with Google".

news.title: Do you find yourself aimlessly scrolling? You're not alone
news.description: A Virgin Media O2 report suggests an average of 36% of time spent on phones is without a clear purpose.

news.title: OpenAI and Anthropic Sign Letter to Prevent AI-Developed Biological Weapons
news.description: Leading AI labs, executives, and scientists are sending a letter to lawmakers urging them to improve tracking of synthetic DNA sequences that could be used for bioweapons.
